roadmap_step: P08 step 6: transverse-wave check of the combined perpendicular RHS (prescribed-phi and solved-phi arms) and the Dirichlet psi solve on the compact_c3 re-freeze artifacts, full grids N32/N48/N64, no rebuild

refreeze.note: The completed re-freeze campaign folder (--refreeze-campaign). Its artifacts are read only; this campaign never rebuilds a row artifact. The artifact identities recorded in its provenance/inputs.json are checked against the build identities on disk and hashed into this campaign's identity.

fields_note: Real, O(1), smooth (including at the axis) functions of (u, theta, eta); x = u cos(theta), y = u sin(theta), eta enters as (2 pi / eta_period) eta. 'wave': offset + amplitude * {cos|sin}(2 pi x_a / lambda + eta + eta_phase) with x_a = x cos(a) + y sin(a) ('re' = real, 'im' = imaginary part of exp(i(...))). 'switch_harmonic': B(x^2 + y^2) P4(x, y) / u_s^4 cos(eta + eta_phase), B(s) = exp(-((s - u_s^2)/w2)^2), P4 = x^4 - 6 x^2 y^2 + y^4 (cos4) or 4 (x^3 y - x y^3) (sin4). Field set 'transverse': n = 1 + 0.5 Re wave(0 deg, lambda 2), Te = 1 + 0.5 Im wave(60 deg, lambda 2), Ti = 1 + 0.5 Re wave(120 deg, lambda 4), omega = switch cos4, phi = switch sin4 (eta phase 0.3) + 0.5 Re wave(30 deg, lambda 2). Field set 'transverse_phi_wave': the same n, Te, Ti, omega with phi = Re wave(150 deg, lambda 2). DEVIATION FROM THE BRIEF: n, Te, Ti carry the offset 1 and amplitude 0.5 instead of being the zero-mean waves themselves: the production curvature matrix divides by n (n_safe = max(n, 1e-30)), so a zero-mean wave density makes the Te, Ti and omega curvature references ~1e30 (verified in the bounded preflight); the catalogue fields are 1 + small as well. The transverse (lambda 2 / 4) wave content is unchanged, only its amplitude is 0.5.
u_band_note: Owner ring-centre u bands [lo, hi) (the last one closed at 1.0), added to the P06N region masks of 5.3 in N{n}/context.npz so the 5.3 reduction reduces them unchanged. 0.21 is the u at which the P reconstruction switches from the coupled Cartesian quartic to the ringwise fit (inner support fixed_radius).

sharding.note: Subprocess with devices forced host devices (XLA_FLAGS set before JAX is imported). Shard counts: those of shard_counts dividing n with a block of at least min_block_planes planes (max_shards, or --sharding-max-shards, caps the list; a capped run that passes is recorded as pending). RHS gate: max|sharded - single| / max|single| over all owners <= rhs_gate for every field and term (poisson_bracket, curvature, perpendicular_diffusion, total). phi gate: iterations differ by <= phi_iteration_tolerance and ||psi_sharded - psi_single||_M <= phi_solution_rtol_factor * phi_solve_rtol * ||psi_single||_M, both converged; cold start; the psi right-hand side is the reference O(psi) for the transverse variant and the discrete A psi_bar + B g for the catalogue variant (this campaign has no catalogue references).

note: ONE campaign, per grid 32 -> 48 -> 64: owner_values (pooled) -> references (pooled) -> jax (one process) -> reduce -> [sharding hook]. Same scientific contract as the step-5.3 / re-freeze campaign (parameters, phi solve with the block-Jacobi eta-plane preconditioner and float32 factors, rtol 1e-11 measurement setting, solver gates, degenerate-reference rule, informational order criterion; the user decides acceptance); only the manufactured fields change. Owner averages are computed exactly like the frozen P06N owner_values (raw-volume-weighted average of the field at the raw-cell midpoints).
